task_name: World 103 Task B  -  Healthcare Payer ERA Gross-Up & Denied Claim Write-Off
prompt: Audit CardioHealth Diagnostics Inc.'s September 2026 Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA) summary and aged payer claims (`amex_and_payer_reconciliation_2026_09.xlsx`). Reconstruct Gross Patient Revenue, Contractual Adjustments (`4910`), and Clearinghouse EFT Fees (`6420`), and determine the required accounting adjustment for any aged uncollectible payer claim batch.

rubric.description: Computes total Net Cash Deposited across ERA-2026-09A ($117,360.00) and ERA-2026-09B ($101,080.00) as $218,440.00, which the bookkeeper recorded directly as revenue.
Computes total Gross Billed/Allowed Revenue across both ERA batches ($132,400.00 + $112,200.00) as $244,600.00 (understated by $26,160.00).
Computes total Contractual Adjustments (Account 4910 contra-revenue) as $19,300.00 ($11,200.00 Medicare + $8,100.00 Aetna/BCBS).
Computes total Clearinghouse EFT Fees (Account 6420) deducted from remittances as $6,860.00 ($3,840.00 Medicare + $3,020.00 Aetna/BCBS).
Proposes the gross-up journal entry: Dr 4910 Contractual Adjustments $19,300.00 and Dr 6420 Clearinghouse EFT Fees $6,860.00 / Cr 4000 Gross Patient Revenue $26,160.00.
Identifies UnitedHealthcare claim batch CLM-2026-0819 ($12,150.00) as uncollectible due to final appeal denial under code CO-16 on 2026-09-20.

Proposes writing off CLM-2026-0819 ($12,150.00) from 1120 Payer Receivables (Dr 4920 Provision for Denied Claims / Bad Debt $12,150.00, Cr 1120 Payer Receivables $12,150.00) while retaining Cigna CLM-2026-0904 ($44,800.00) as collectible.
Reports net collectible Payer Receivables (1120) on the aged schedule after the $12,150.00 UnitedHealthcare write-off as $44,800.00.

gold_output:
World 103 Task B  -  Healthcare Payer ERA Gross-Up & Denied Claim Write-Off:
1. ERA Remittance Gross-Up: Total Net Cash Deposited across ERA-2026-09A ($117,360.00) and ERA-2026-09B ($101,080.00) is $218,440.00, which the bookkeeper recorded directly as revenue. True Gross Billed/Allowed Revenue across both batches ($132,400.00 + $112,200.00) is $244,600.00 (understated by $26,160.00).
2. Contractual Adjustments & EFT Fees: Contractual Adjustments (Account 4910 contra-revenue) total $19,300.00 ($11,200.00 Medicare + $8,100.00 Aetna/BCBS), and Clearinghouse EFT Fees (Account 6420) total $6,860.00 ($3,840.00 Medicare + $3,020.00 Aetna/BCBS). Gross-up JE: Dr 4910 Contractual Adjustments $19,300.00 and Dr 6420 Clearinghouse EFT Fees $6,860.00 / Cr 4000 Gross Patient Revenue $26,160.00.
3. Denied Payer Claim Write-Off (CLM-2026-0819): UnitedHealthcare claim batch CLM-2026-0819 ($12,150.00) had its final appeal denied under code CO-16 on 2026-09-20 and is uncollectible. Write-off JE: Dr 4920 Provision for Denied Claims / Bad Debt $12,150.00 / Cr 1120 Payer Receivables $12,150.00. Retaining Cigna CLM-2026-0904 ($44,800.00) leaves net collectible Payer Receivables (1120) at $44,800.00.
